tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs

rin chen myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ na mo gu ru we/ dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs rin chen myu gu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen sgyu ma'i rol pa can/ /thugs rje'i stobs la phyag byas nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs snying po ni/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis bshad par bya/ /de la dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo sgrub par 'dod pas/ 'di ltar sgom ste/ lus kyi zhen pa bzlog pa'i don du bskyed rim/ ngag gi zhen pa bzlog pa'i don du bzlas pa/ sems kyi zhen pa bzlog pa'i don du rdzogs rim sgom pa ste gsum las/ dang po la bcu bzhi las/ dang po bla ma dag pa'i cho ga ni/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi par raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de'i 'od kyis gdod ma'i gnas nas he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor chen po shar gyi 'khyams su bla ma mi bskyod pa dang bcas pa rang gi mdun du badzra sa mā dzaḥ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyi rtse mo las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga'i rang bzhin lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha āḥhūṃ/ zhes sogs nyer spyod lnga dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ gsang mchod yid kyi dran tsam byas/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du bstsal dang yid rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams dang*/ /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yid rang ngo*/ /sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*/ /gsang sngags theg pa bla med pa'i/ /chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed pa/

/de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni sangs rgyas shog /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi/ / gnyis pa tshad med bzhi sgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang*/ sogs bya/ gsum pa stong nyid sgom pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis phyi snod bcud dang*/ bdag lus dang snying ga'i padma dang*/ hūṃ rnams rim pas gcig la gcig thim zhing*/ hūṃ yang je phra la stong par thim/ oṃ shu n+ya ta = sogs/ bzhi pa bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa gur dang*/ dra ba dang*/ rwa ba rdo rje rkyang pas gtams pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur/ lnga pa rten dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa ni/ de'i nang du e las chos 'byung gi dbus su/ yaṃ las rlung sngon po zla gaṃ / raṃ las me dmar po gru gsum/ baṃ las chu dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa ser po gru bzhi rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i dbus su rin po che'i ri rab kyi steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i dbus su bhruṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab bzhi/ pañtsa ro kha'i rtsig pa dang*/ 'dod snam pha gu dra phyed shar bu mnga' yab rnams dang*/ nang ka ba brgyad dang*/ rdo rje'i gdung zlum dang*/ thal gdung dang rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog dang bcas pa/ rgya phubs mchod rten mgo lnga pa lta bu/ steng 'og gi gzhi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ phyi rol dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ / bsdus pa sgom pa'i tshe chos 'byung sgom pa nas 'di'i bar bor yang rung ngo*/ /dbus su paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/

dbus su hrīḥyig go /de zhu ba las thig le dkar po lnga grub pa lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la 'khod par gyur/ phyogs bzhi'i thig le rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus te/ shar nas g.yas bskor gyi/ hūṃ sngon po/ swā ser po/ āḥdamar po/ hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ yang 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus thim pa las/ shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu padma/ byang du ral gri rnams/ hūṃ swā āḥhā rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ de rnams las kyang 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can rnams kyi phung po bzhi dang 'byung ba bzhi sbyangs/ tshad med bzhi dang ye shes bzhi la bkod/ slar 'dus pa las/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po rdo rje/ g.yon dang po dril bu/ gnyis pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas gnyis pa thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa lce sbyang gi mgrin pa brtsir ba/ g.yas gnyis pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo'am dkar mo'am dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dkar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po padma/ g.yon dang po thod pa/ gnyis pa gzhu/ g.yas gnyis pa mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' mgro ma ljang khu/ ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ g.yas dang po ral gri/ g.yon dang po zhags pa/ gnyis pas ka pā la/ g.yas gnyis pa ḍā ma ru bsnams pa'o/ / drug pa glus bskul ba ni/ de ltar lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyi padma rab phye shig /a la la la la ho/ /bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od kyis padma rab kha 'byed pa bzhin/ /a la la la la ho/ bde ba chen por rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig

/ ces bskul/ bdun pa gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi thig le las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las hūṃ sngon po'o/ /de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las/ rdo rje sngon po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las rigs lnga'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa spros/ ye shes lnga la bkod/ yang 'dus pa las dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma phyogs kyi gos can la 'khyud pa/ dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ khro chags mdzes shing sgeg pa rab tu khros pas 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/ skra ser gyen brdzes/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ gar dgus rol ba/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis nyi ma'i steng du/ mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba thod skam gyi phreng ba can/ lhag ma gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ 'khor bzhi po ni phyag g.yas dang po thugs ka /g.yon dang po gsang gnas/ phyag 'og ma gnyis dpung pa'i thad kar phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /thams cad la zhal gyi kha dog ni g.yas bskor du go bar bya zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad g.yas brkyang gis gar stabs dang*/ 'khyud yum ma gtogs gzhan rnams de ltar dang gtso bo'i rgyab zhal dkar po dang*/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal byed pa sogs kyang gdam nga yin pas gang mos pa de ltar sgom mo/ /brgyad pa skye mched sogs la yi ge dgod pa ni/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna ba la a dmar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

snying gar ra dmar po/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yang snying gar raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /dgu pa ye shes pa bsre ba ni/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ o dharma dhā tu badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ bcu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ puṣpe= sogs kyis mchod/ dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i 'od kyi rtse mo nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo dang rdo rje ma la mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma la rnam snang*/ rin chen ma la rin 'byung*/ padma la snang mtha'/ sna tshogs ma la don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ bcu gcig pa mchod pa ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las mchod pa'i lha mo spros/ arghaṃ sogs/ gong bzhin no/ /bcu gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa'i/ /he ru ka dpal phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i mgo bor oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ gsang gnas su āḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la ha ljang khu/ mkha' gsang stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje oṃ las nor bu/ hrīḥlas padma bhruṃ las ze'u 'bru'o/ /'khyud pa dang tsum la sogs pas shes rab ma la bde ba skyes pa na/ lha mo bzhis/ e ma gnyen mchog= sogs kyis bskul bas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal dang bcas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i phaṭa yig gis sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ dhu tī'i lam nas padmar lhung ba'i bde ba byang chub kyi sems lha rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus drangs te myangs par gyur/

bcu bzhi pa rnam dag sgom pa ni/ chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i sku mdog sngon po/ rnam thar bzhis zhal bzhi/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i spyan gsum/ dmigs med kyi ye shes 'bar bas dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ ye shes lnga'i thod pa lngas dbu brgyan pa/ nyon mongs pa gcod pas mche ba gtsigs pa/ 'phrin las bzhi'i phyag bzhi/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis rus pa'i rgyan drug /thugs rje chen po'i rtags su mi mgo'i 'phreng ba/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pas yum dang gnyis su med pa/ 'khor bzhi ni 'byung ba bzhi dang*/ phung po bzhi dang*/ ye shes bzhi'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yin no/ / gnyis pa ngag gi zhen pa bzlog pa'i don du bzlas pa ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ hūṃ/ dpal he ru ka'i snying po'o/ / oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyi sngags so/ /snying gar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su sngags phreng sgom pa sogs bzlas pa'i dmigs pa la yang gsal 'debs dgos la sngags kyi ngo bo gzhung 'ga' las/ sa bon rnams la de nyid gsum spel du mdzad pa dang*/ jo bo rje'i rgya dpe la de nyid lnga spel yang snang la/ kho bo'i bla ma rgya gar paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig gi zhal nas/ he ru ka'i spyi sngags kyang bzla gsung ngo*/ /gsum pa sems kyi zhen pa bzlog pa'i don du rdzogs rim sgom pa ni/ khrid yig tu bshad zin to/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyi rang bzhin du byas te bdag nyid la thim/ yum yang yab la thim/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma yang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim ste rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ gnas gsum dang mig sogs kyi yi ge rnams yid kyis dran tsam bya/

brjod par spro na gong bzhin brjod/ dag gis byas pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro sgom gyur cig /de yis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bdag /'gro mgon phun sum tshogs gyur cig / ces smon lam btab ste thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su mi'i sha dang byang sems/ shar du glang po'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba glang gi sha dang rakta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang rgyud pa/ de rnams rnam pa oṃ/ srog a yig lngar gnas pa/ de'i steng du huṃ oṃ swā ā he/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ a las zla ba phyed pa/ hūṃ las rdo rje phyed pa rnams brtsegs pa'o/ /rlung gis me sbar/ bdud rtsi skol ba'i 'od kyis zla ba dang rdo rje bzhu nas thim/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab cing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badzrā ka ka pra be shā ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī naṃ hri da yaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ thams cad mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badzrā pra tītstshe maṃ bā liṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā ling hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā ling hrīḥphaṭa/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā liṃ āḥphaṭa/

/oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā liṃ ho phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tītstshe maṃ bā liṃ ha ha ho phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ / rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ / rang bzhin mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /padma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /

zhes brjod cing rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i don bsam pa/ 'di skabs chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la snang ngo*/ /yul bdag dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams la gtor ma phul bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ che ge mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i/ kṣe tra pā la i da ཾ bā liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa ma ma sa pa ri wā rā' na sarba satwa nañtsa sarba pā paṃ bya te bighnān shintaṃ ku ru dha na ka sya ā yuḥ a ro kya puṣtaṃ ku ru sarba bha yaṃ rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul zhing*/ 'di skabs su yul che ge mo zhes bya ba'i gnas su/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa la sogs pa sarba kṣe tra pā la sogs sbyor ba phyag len yin no/ / he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gror bcas/ /phyogs skyong dur khrod ma tshogs rnams/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /nad gdon bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ /'bru nor 'khor dang tshe rgyas mdzod/ / dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod/ / ces 'phrin las gzhol/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*/ / sangs rgyas nyid dang 'phrad 'gyur pa'i/ /lam 'di nyid du 'gro bar shog /ma sgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab/ oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'dir gtor chog bsdus pa rgyun 'khyer yin/ rgyas pa ni/ mdun du rten gyi dkyil 'khor zhing skyong dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyi thig le lnga las lha tshogs bskyed/ sems can thams cad lha'i 'khor lor dag par mos/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin no/ /rang nyid bdud rtsi ril bu bza' ba dang*/

zas za ba'i tshe/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu hya a bha kṣe hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs nas bza'o/ / rnal 'byor yan lag gzhan rnams ni spyi dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /tā ra nā thas sbyar ba las/ /dge ba gang thob de yis ni/ /'gro kun thugs rje'i stobs su shog /dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs rin chen myu gu zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //'di ni thog mar rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig gi rjes su 'brang ste shin tu bsdus pa zhig sbyar ba/ slad kyi don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba las/ ku ku ri pa dang*/ shānti pa'i bzhed gzhung las mar rngog gi man ngag gis legs par brgyan nas cung zad rgyas par phye ba ste/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gcig pa la shin tu dag par bcos shing*/ rgyas bsdus kyi skyon mtha' dag dang bral bar byas pa/ sgrub pa'i thabs 'di dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron me dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid yig rgyal ba'i lam bzang zhes pa ste/ kho bos sbyar ba'i bstan bcos rnam pa gsum po 'di ma bu ya ma bral bar bya zhing*/ zab don nges gnas mtha' dag rgyud kyi rnam bshad du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /bkra shis/ /maṅga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal mahā mā ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs rin chen myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 10 -- PAGE 11 -- PAGE 1 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
